name: CLOBOT Co., Ltd
summary: CLOBOT Co., Ltd operates as a robotics integration company in Korea. It develops CHAMELEON software for general-purpose autonomous robots; fleet management system (FMS) for heterogeneous robots; and CROMS, a cloud-based robot control system. The company also provides robot service planning, robot operation and maintenance services, and robot supply services. It serves logistics, factories, and hospitals. The company was incorporated in 2017 and is based in Bundang-gu, South Korea.
